headline: Five controllers, one pad
lede: Jon's Remote-Play ask shipped: switchable touch overlays (D-pad, stick, full Sony pad, pointer, tilt), chosen per game from the pause menu and remembered, all feeding the exact same input rail the games, recordings and model slots already read.

notes.text: #3108 PADTYPES: the decision layer is one pure module — a game's default derives from what it already declared, so every untouched title keeps its pad byte-for-byte. Pilots: SSX full pad, MARBLE MADNESS tilt, PAC-MAN dpad+stick.

TILT is honest: one ENABLE tap (iOS motion permission), RE-CENTER pins the pose in your hand as neutral, portrait and landscape steer the same physical roll. Found live: a saved choice didn't apply on a fresh load — padtypecheck now pins the re-fire.
SSX's own z-60 stick and trick chips (their #894 answers) now step aside under the full pad instead of doubling verbs — both collisions found by driving it in a real tab, not by review.
padtypecheck joined CI (CORE.checks, 56 pins, mutant-proven); padtypeplay drives the five types on real touch lane-side. Rollout to more titles filed as #3118.

look.text: SSX on the full pad — switch to STICK in the pause menu and it remembers
MARBLE MADNESS by tilting your phone — enable, re-centre, roll
